title: Tokyo
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Tokyo, red Player card. Coordinates 35°41'22"N 139°41'30"E. The compass has an anchor, so the city is a port. One covered SEARCH box fills the map. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. Printed code P3-20b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Companion Spies. This card counts as 2 unique red cards for the Recon action. Two red squares marked A and B show the two counts. They are not doors.

states.summary: Same Player back. The SEARCH box is scratched. Companion Spies. This card counts as 2 unique red cards for the Recon action. Two red squares marked A and B show the two counts. They are not doors.

rules: Red Player card for Tokyo. Port: the compass has an anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is that box scratched. Side A stays the Player deck back.
The scratch reveals Companion Spies. For the Recon action, this one card counts as 2 unique red cards.
The red squares labeled A and B are the two counts. They are not door codes, and this search opens nothing.
notes: Card id 10719. State 2 card id 10730. One copy.
Coordinates 35°41'22"N 139°41'30"E. Printed code P3-20b stays on the scratched face.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
The picture is two masked figures.
